test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 8th November 2021)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

The box was _______ heavy for that little child to carry.
solution:
The correct answer is 'too.' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• In the given sentence the **adverb **'*too*' is the correct choice to fill.
 
• **Too **means *more than enough*. It is used in a **negative sense**. As we want to convey that the box is heavy enough so that the little child will **not be able to **(*negative sense*) lift it, we use the **adjective ***too*.
 
 
• **Example:** *He was **too **nervous to perform well on the stage.*
 
 
 
• Thus *option 3 *is the correct answer.

The correct sentence is: *The box was **too** heavy for that little child to carry.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Let's learn more about the sentence of having **too...to**:

 
 
• In a sentence, the words **too…to **have a **negative meaning**. It means ‘*more than is necessary or desirable*’. 
 
• Example: 
 
 
• *I was **too **busy **to **talk to her. *(it means **I was very busy. I could not talk to her**.)
 
• *The task was **too **difficult **to **do without help.* (it means **the task was very difficult. I could not do it without help**.)
